messages:
elaine-partnerships: Heads-up — Q3 push idea: a "Seed-to-scale" marketplace offer to convert high-intent trials into committed buckets. Goal: low-friction onboarding credit + staged discounts that scale with usage and time. Need quick sanity checks on: seller readiness, SKU/metering implications, legal renewal gating, and finance uplift model. cc @sam-sales @diego-partnerops @amanda-legal :seedling:

sam-sales: love the name. quick Q — do we keep normal ACV commission on the seed tranche or cap it? worried about reps pushing credits instead of net-new bookings. :thinking_face:

diego-partnerops: from ops side — metering + credits are the big lift. marketplace supports non-consumption credits but mapping to SKU/consumption for billing reconciliation is messy if we have multiple SKUs per offer. need eng input.

amanda-legal: high level legal flags: 1) define "seed" as time-limited refundable credit (non-transferable), 2) renewal opt-in gating (only customers that hit 60% of committed spend in last 90 days can auto-renew), 3) no retroactive credit adjustments after renewal. will draft clause.

finance-ops: quick model sketch: `seed_credit=15k; expected_conversion=0.22; avg_TTM=10k -> projected_ARR = seed_credit*expected_conversion*12/term_months` — rough but suggests positive payback if conversion >=20% within 6mo. I'll run a cohort sim.

eng-marketplace: we can implement a two-stage SKU: `seed-credits` + `usage-meter` and reconcile with a daily job. ETA ~2 weeks for end-to-end (listing + metering + reconciliation hooks). caveat: analytics dashboard will need an extra column for credit burn.

sam-sales: OK on commission — propose keep standard split but carve out a 6mo accelerated kicker if customer converts to committed >50k ARR. keeps reps motivated.

elaine-partnerships: sounds reasonable. ops: can you prototype a sample listing and policy text we can hand to sellers? also need a 1-pager sell sheet + demo script.

marketplace-bot: Draft listing created: https://marketplace.internal/redwood/drafts/seed-to-scale (internal).

eng-marketplace: ping @diego-partnerops — prototype listing uses `seed_credit_v1` SKU and `commit_discount_slab` metadata. will push PR to staging by EOD Friday.

amanda-legal: I'll post a short clause doc in google drive and link here once ready. reminder: include clear termination language for early cancellations.

finance-ops: I'll run ARR/cashflow sims and post numbers Tues. also recommend a cap on seed credits per account to limit downside.

elaine-partnerships: Action items recap: 1) @eng-marketplace prototype listing + reconciliation PR (ETA Fri EOD), 2) @finance-ops run cohort sims (ETA Tue), 3) @amanda-legal draft renewal/termination clause (ETA Tue), 4) @sam-sales draft seller play + commission kicker language (ETA Wed), 5) @diego-partnerops validate ops runbook + support ticket flow (ETA Wed). If no blockers we'll pilot with 3 SI partners in early Aug. :calendar:

sam-sales: :thumbsup: pushing to our top 10 sellers next week to get feedback on messaging.

diego-partnerops: noted — I'll also create a quick runbook for support on credit reconciliations and escalate SLA for the pilot.

elaine-partnerships: awesome — will collate all artifacts into a single playbook doc and schedule a 30m sync Fri. thanks all! :rocket:
